blurb: Voyageur Canoe Outfitters provides outfitting for wilderness canoe camping trips in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness and Quetico Provincial Park. Guests can rent complete or partial outfitting packages, stay in private bunkhouses, or rent cabins at the resort. The location is on Saganaga Lake and the Seagull River, a BWCAW entry point, offering a tranquil lakefront setting.
